voices.label: First Encounter
voices.en:
Ah! The troopers are here! Get out of ...
Huh? You are not one of them? I am so, so sorry!
voices.zh:
啊！追兵追上来了，快点离开这里……
啊？您不是追兵吗？实在、实在是对不起！

voices.label: Suitcase Climate
voices.en:
What a nice day. There will be such a large audience to ... night.
Ah! My stomach, it hurts ... so much ... I'm not lying!
voices.zh:
今天的天气不错，晚上一定会有很多观众……的。
啊！我的肚子好疼，真的好疼，是……是真的！

voices.label: To the Future
voices.en:
Even if we do go back to the future, I still wanna go back farming ...
Grow some potatoes, corn, raise some cattle.
voices.zh:
就算真的回到了未来，我也还是想回家种地……
我可以种点土豆，还有玉米，再养一些牛。

voices.label: Idle
voices.en:
Silence on the stage is only a tiny lingering charm
before the next magnificent show ...
Um, what am I talking about!
... Whew, thank goodness nobody noticed me.
voices.zh:
舞台也会有沉寂之时。
不过，这只是下一场盛大演出前，不值一提的余韵而已——
呃、我在说什么啊！
……呜，幸好没有人注意到我。

voices.label: Greetings
voices.en: I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
voices.zh: 对不起！对不起！

voices.label: Morning
voices.en:
Beautiful sunshine means a beautiful day ...
Hmm, people like me, who cannot do anything well, really don't deserve to be standing in the sun ...
voices.zh:
美好的阳光象征着美好的一天……
呜，像我这样什么都做不好的人，实在羞愧于站在阳光下……

voices.label: Bond: Morning
voices.en:
Good morning. Why am I in a good mood today, you ask?
Because the company takes a day off.
voices.zh:
早上好～我看起来心情很好吗？
大概是因为今天剧团休息吧……

voices.label: Night
voices.en: Everyone else is ready? Mmm ... my feet ... I can't move my feet!
voices.zh: 其他人已经准备就绪了吗？呜呜……脚、脚怎么走不动了！

voices.label: Bond: Night
voices.en: The light is on ... It's time for me to go on stage.
voices.zh: 舞台的灯光已经亮起……到了不得不上场的时候了啊……

voices.label: Hat and Hair
voices.en:
The illusion I create can only fool the eyes ...
My arcane skill is not of much use.
voices.zh:
我所制造的幻象是只能骗到眼睛的假象……
是个没什么用的神秘术。

voices.label: Sleeves and Hands
voices.en: If none of these troubles had happened ... I would probably be milking the cow right now ... *sighs*
voices.zh: 如果没有这趟子乱事儿，我现在还在挤牛奶吧……啊……

voices.label: Clothing and Torso
voices.en:
... It's indeed too much!
I've told the cast do not pick this outfit ...
voices.zh:
……果然还是太华丽了！
我早就跟团员们说过不要选这套了……

voices.label: Hobby
voices.en:
Only when standing on the stage, when saying the lines ...
Could I forget the fact that I'm such a useless, undeserving person ...
voices.zh:
唯有在舞台之上，唯有说出那一句句台词的时候……
我才能够忘记自己是一个无能的、不值得期待的人……

voices.label: Praise
voices.en:
Br ... brilliant! Your achievements are soaring like a harrier in the sky,
one can only admire but not be cynical.
voices.zh:
太、太厉害了！您的杰出功绩，如同飞翔于天际之鹞鸥一般。
让人唯有赞叹，而无嫉恨。

voices.label: Intimacy
voices.en: I ... I will be brave ... Just like you!
voices.zh: 我、我会勇敢起来的……像你一样！

voices.label: Chitchat I
voices.en:
People, people! Why are we wooing for our own destruction?
Why not just take my word and go back home farming?!
voices.zh:
剧团、剧团！我们为什么要找死呢？！
听我一句劝，大家收拾行李回乡下养牛种地不好吗？！

voices.label: Chitchat II
voices.en: An't be my destiny, so. An't be not, so. He that dies this year is quit for the next.
voices.zh: 死也好，活也罢，这都是命运。今年死了明年总不会再死。

voices.label: Monologue
voices.en:
Each one of us struggles to survive for a certain reason.
Bloodline, responsibility, pursuit, vocation ...
If the illusion I created could be one of their reasons ...
that would be enough.
voices.zh:
我们每个人都是为了某些理由而坚持生存的。
血脉、责任、理想、使命……
如果我制造的幻影或许能够成为某个人的理由……
这就足够了。

voices.label: Deployment
voices.en: Don ... don't look at me ... I'm not the one you saw on the wanted list ...
voices.zh: 别、别看我，我不是你们在通缉令上看到的人……

voices.label: Pre-Battle
voices.en:
Did the show begin?
Excellent, get ready to step onto the stage.
voices.zh:
演出开始了吗？
很好，准备步入舞台吧。

voices.label: Select Incantation I
voices.en: Let the show begin.
voices.zh: 开演吧。

voices.label: Select Incantation II
voices.en: Heh heh.
voices.zh: 呵。

voices.label: Select 3-star Incantation
voices.en: I shall take thy word.
voices.zh: 我将采纳你的觐言。

voices.label: Select Ultimate
voices.en: This shall be my only act!
voices.zh: 这将是我的独幕！

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill I
voices.en: Illusion is enough for them.
voices.zh: 尽管只是幻象，但也足够了。

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill I
voices.en: Foolish.
voices.zh: 一群愚蠢之徒。

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill II
voices.en: Ye provoked me.
voices.zh: 你们惹怒了我。

voices.label: Cast Arcane Skill II
voices.en: Enough.
voices.zh: 到此为止吧。

voices.label: Cast Ultimate
voices.en: Thy ending is destined.
voices.zh: 你们的结局已然注定。

voices.label: Attacked I
voices.en: Malapert!
voices.zh: 无礼之徒！

voices.label: Attacked II
voices.en: Annoying bugs.
voices.zh: 烦人的苍蝇。

voices.label: Battle Victory
voices.en:
That's what you've got?
... Huh? I'm sorry!
voices.zh:
你们就这种水平吗？
……啊？对不起！

voices.label: Insight
voices.en: Umm ... Are you sure you're not making a mistake ... choosing me?
voices.zh: 唔……您没有搞错什么东西吧……真的是我吗？

voices.label: Bottom of Insight
voices.en:
Aye ... aye!
Be it tyrant or tyranny, people's right for joy cannot be snatched away.
voices.zh:
没错……没错！
不管是暴君还是暴力，都无法夺走人们的欢愉的权利。
